name: qonto
description: Connect Qonto to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use Qonto MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect Qonto to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with business banking and cards using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my Qonto workspace.
Find anything in Qonto that needs attention and explain why.
Help me review business banking and cards in Qonto.
